description: Ministry of Provincial Council and Local Government - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2006/44 of 17.02.2017, under Sec. 3D of the LAE Ordinance
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to corrections and alterations to electoral boundaries and ward details for local authorities, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral boundary changes and corrections to ward names and details, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes and boundary adjustments.
